title: api-config-runtime-shape-sketch-jamie-notes
content:
Context: quick personal sketch for new api config shape and runtime routing spec. Leave rough - will iterate with Samir/Evan.

Goals:
- single source-of-truth config for route-level behavior (latency SLO, model selection, batching, cache policy)
- compact shape so frontend + SDK can validate client-side (TypeScript)
- allow per-tenant overrides + global defaults + rollout windowing

Open questions:
- how to express fallback model chains? simple list vs weighted list? (need sim).
- do we include token-cost-estimate hints? probably optional field.
- TTL for KV-prefix cache entries: per-route vs global policy?

Rough sketch (flat-ish JSON shape that maps cleanly to TS types):

{
  "route": "string",             // logical route id e.g. "chat.generate.v1"
  "default_model": "string",   // model id or alias (e.g. "redwood/gpt-j-8b-q4")
  "model_fallbacks": ["string"],// ordered fallbacks if primary is unavailable
  "slo": {
    "p95_ms": "number",         // target latency in ms
    "max_ms": "number"         // hard cap / circuit-break
  },
  "batching": {
    "enabled": "boolean",
    "max_batch_tokens": "number",
    "window_ms": "number"
  },
  "kv_cache": {
    "enabled": "boolean",
    "scope": "string",         // "route" | "global" | "tenant"
    "ttl_seconds": "number"
  },
  "quality": {
    "prompt_validation": "boolean",
    "min_confidence": "number" // used by eval probes
  },
  "cost_hints": {
    "tokens_per_request": "number",
    "estimate_usd_per_1m_tokens": "number"
  },
  "rollout": {
    "strategy": "string",      // "canary" | "weighted" | "percent"
    "targets": [                // for weighted: [{\"model\": \"id\", \"weight\": 10}] but keep shape flexible
      "string"
    ],
    "start_ts": "string",     // ISO
    "end_ts": "string"
  },
  "annotations": ["string"]   // free text tags for ops/debugging
}

Notes on shape decisions:
- Keep model_fallbacks as ordered list. weighted fallback complicates routing; can add later if needed.
- Rollout.strategy: simplest first (canary -> percent -> manual weighted). For weighted we probably need a small sub-schema; can evolve.
- SLO fields kept numeric to allow runtime evaluation by router. router will compute whether to route to dedicated pools vs hosted.

Runtime routing logic (sketch):
- Evaluate route config -> check tenant overrides -> merge with global defaults.
- If model primary is healthy and capacity available -> route to primary.
- If primary overloaded or unreachable AND model_fallbacks present -> try sequentially.
- If latency predicted > slo.max_ms -> short-circuit to fallback model with lower latency profile (quantized) and tag response with "graceful-degrade".
- If rollout.strategy == "weighted": sample by weight (seeded RNG per request-id).

KV-cache behavior:
- Default scope = "route". For high-entropy chat use per-tenant to avoid cross-tenant pollution.
- TTL default 300s. Allow per-route override to 0 to disable.

Metrics & telemetry to emit per-request:
- model_id_used, model_variant, latency_ms, batch_size, cache_hit (bool), route_id, tenant_id, rollout_bucket, cost_estimate_tokens

API + SDK implications:
- Expose route config read endpoint (GET /v1/routes/:id/config) for debugging.
- SDK should allow client-side validation of config when using local dev mode. Provide TS types auto-generated from canonical JSON schema.

TODOs:
- [ ] formalize JSON Schema + ts typegen pipeline (Samir owns).
- [ ] add unit tests for routing logic sim (Evan).
- [ ] add lightweight fallback-weight field if we want weighted fallback behavior.
- [ ] decide storage format: compact flat vs nested namespaced (prefer flat to ease merges).

Meeting notes snippet (from 2025-11-05 sync):
- Casey: preferred simple ordered fallback; implement weighted later.
- Samir: wants rollout object to be expressive for A/B (need to support "treatment" metadata).
- Evan: suggested "cost_hints" for route owners to understand economics.

Next steps:
- Draft JSON Schema in repo: redwood-inference/config-schemas/route-config.schema.json (WIP).
- PR w/ schema + ts typegen example + small router sim. Link to PR in linked_artifacts.

Random notes to self: keep docs in Console showing route-level cost breakdown (tie back to cost_hints). Also show a "why routed to fallback" reason in traces.

---
End of sketch. Will tidy after Samir review.
